extension.summary: Top Hacker News stories and their best comments, on your TV
extension.description: Cycles through the current stories on Hacker News, with the title, domain, points, author and age of each, and then its top-rated comments, one at a time and paced to reading speed. Choose the list (Top, Best, New, Ask, Show), how many stories and comments to show, whether the first reply comes along, and how fast you read. Three themes, an optional clock, and a slow drift to protect OLED and plasma screens from burn-in. It starts instantly from a cache and refreshes in the background; if the network is down it keeps showing the last stories it had. Any key exits at once.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial client. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Y Combinator or Hacker News. Story titles, scores and comments are the work of their authors, read here from Hacker News' public read-only API.
